tex_content.html:
Definition

For a covering map $\pi :E\to M$, a covering (deck) transformation is a homeomorphism $\varphi :E\to E$ with $\pi \circ \varphi =\pi $. These transformations form the group $\operatorname {Aut}_\pi (E)$ under composition and act on $E$ by $\varphi \cdot q=\varphi (q)$. The action is transitive on each fiber exactly when $\pi _*(\pi _1(E,q))\triangleleft \pi _1(M,\pi (q))$ for every $q$ (the normal-covering condition).
